correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of the stated invasion fitness gives the selection gradient \(D_r(x)=(-2+3r)(x-1/2)\), convergence slope \(-2+3r\), and mutant-direction curvature \(-1+2r\). At \(x=1/2\) the exact invasion fitness is \((2r-1)(y-1/2)^2/2\). Thus convergence stability holds for \(r<2/3\), ESS curvature for \(r<1/2\), and disruptive curvature for \(1/2<r<2/3\). The degenerate endpoints are correctly excluded from the strict branching interval.
